Property where an operation produces the same result whether executed once or multiple times. Prevents duplicate processing.
Abstraction layer that mediates between domain and data mapping layers, providing collection-like access to domain objects.
Maintains a list of objects affected by a business transaction and coordinates writing out changes as a single atomic operation.
Encapsulates query criteria in reusable objects, enabling composition of complex business rules and filtering logic.
Pattern that decouples message queue implementation from business logic, enabling runtime transport selection.
Entity Framework Core — lightweight, extensible ORM for .NET supporting multiple database providers.
ASP.NET Core feature for storing sensitive configuration during development, outside source control.
Layered architecture where dependencies point inward toward domain logic, keeping frameworks and UI at the outer edges.
Data Transfer Object — lightweight object for carrying data between processes, decoupling internal models from API contracts.
C# feature enabling addition of methods to existing types without modifying them, used for modular service registration.
